name: AxisSides
description: Trade side enum + helpers (export enum / export method pattern).
content:
//@version=6
// @description Side enum and signal helpers
library("AxisSides")

export enum Side
    flat
    long
    short

export sideFromBool(bool isLong, bool isShort) =>
    isLong ? Side.long : isShort ? Side.short : Side.flat

export isLong(Side s) =>
    s == Side.long

export isShort(Side s) =>
    s == Side.short

export invert(Side s) =>
    s == Side.long ? Side.short : s == Side.short ? Side.long : Side.flat

export labelOf(Side s) =>
    switch s
        Side.long => "LONG"
        Side.short => "SHORT"
        => "FLAT"

name: AxisMA
description: Moving-average family behind a v6 enum switch.
content:
//@version=6
// @description Multi-type moving averages via enum + switch
library("AxisMA")

export enum MaKind
    sma
    ema
    wma
    rma
    hma

export ma(float src, simple int len, MaKind kind = MaKind.ema) =>
    switch kind
        MaKind.sma => ta.sma(src, len)
        MaKind.ema => ta.ema(src, len)
        MaKind.wma => ta.wma(src, len)
        MaKind.rma => ta.rma(src, len)
        MaKind.hma => ta.hma(src, len)
        => ta.ema(src, len)

export ribbon(float src, simple int fast, simple int slow, MaKind kind = MaKind.ema) =>
    [ma(src, fast, kind), ma(src, slow, kind)]

name: AxisRisk
description: Position sizing and stop math (percent / ATR / R-multiple).
content:
//@version=6
// @description Risk and position-size helpers
library("AxisRisk")

export const float DEFAULT_RISK_PCT = 1.0

/// Units from equity risk % and stop distance (price units)
export sizeFromRisk(float equity, float riskPct, float stopDist) =>
    stopDist <= 0 ? 0.0 : (equity * riskPct / 100.0) / stopDist

export stopAtr(float atr, float mult) =>
    atr * mult

export takeProfitR(float entry, float stop, float rMultiple, bool isLong) =>
    float risk = math.abs(entry - stop)
    isLong ? entry + risk * rMultiple : entry - risk * rMultiple

export trailOffset(float atr, float mult) =>
    atr * mult

name: AxisPoint
description: UDT point + methods (export type / method style).
content:
//@version=6
// @description 2D point UDT with methods
library("AxisPoint")

export type Point
    float x
    float y

export newPoint(float x, float y) =>
    Point.new(x, y)

export method dist(Point this, Point other) =>
    math.sqrt(math.pow(this.x - other.x, 2) + math.pow(this.y - other.y, 2))

export method midpoint(Point this, Point other) =>
    Point.new((this.x + other.x) / 2.0, (this.y + other.y) / 2.0)

export method translate(Point this, float dx, float dy) =>
    Point.new(this.x + dx, this.y + dy)

name: AxisSession
description: Session / time-of-day filters with dynamic string windows.
content:
//@version=6
// @description Session filter helpers
library("AxisSession")

export const string RTH_US = "0930-1600"
export const string LONDON = "0800-1630"
export const string ASIA = "0000-0900"

export inSession(string sess, string tz = "America/New_York") =>
    not na(time(timeframe.period, sess, tz))

export sessionChange(string sess, string tz = "America/New_York") =>
    bool now = inSession(sess, tz)
    now and not now[1]

export minutesSinceOpen(string sess, string tz = "America/New_York") =>
    // approximate: bar time vs session open is host-dependent; use hour*60+minute
    hour(time, tz) * 60 + minute(time, tz)

name: AxisStats
description: Array rolling stats (avg, stdev, zscore, percentile).
content:
//@version=6
// @description Rolling array statistics
library("AxisStats")

export pushCap(array<float> a, float v, int cap) =>
    array.push(a, v)
    while array.size(a) > cap
        array.shift(a)
    a

export mean(array<float> a) =>
    array.size(a) == 0 ? na : array.avg(a)

export stdev(array<float> a) =>
    array.size(a) < 2 ? na : array.stdev(a)

export zscore(array<float> a, float v) =>
    float m = mean(a)
    float s = stdev(a)
    na(m) or na(s) or s == 0 ? na : (v - m) / s

export pctRank(array<float> a, float v) =>
    array.size(a) == 0 ? na : array.percentrank(a, array.indexof(a, v))

name: AxisFib
description: Fibonacci ratios as export const + level builders.
content:
//@version=6
// @description Fibonacci constants and retracement levels
library("AxisFib")

export const float R236 = 0.236
export const float R382 = 0.382
export const float R500 = 0.500
export const float R618 = 0.618
export const float R786 = 0.786
export const float E1272 = 1.272
export const float E1618 = 1.618

export retrace(float highPrice, float lowPrice, float ratio) =>
    highPrice - (highPrice - lowPrice) * ratio

export extend(float highPrice, float lowPrice, float ratio, bool up) =>
    float rng = highPrice - lowPrice
    up ? highPrice + rng * (ratio - 1.0) : lowPrice - rng * (ratio - 1.0)

export levels(float hi, float lo) =>
    array.from(
         retrace(hi, lo, R236),
         retrace(hi, lo, R382),
         retrace(hi, lo, R500),
         retrace(hi, lo, R618),
         retrace(hi, lo, R786))

name: AxisAlerts

//@version=6
// @description Alert / log message helpers
library("AxisAlerts")

export fmtPrice(float p, int digits = 2) =>
    str.tostring(p, "#." + str.repeat("0", digits))

export entryMsg(string side, string sym, float price) =>
    side + " " + sym + " @ " + fmtPrice(price)

export exitMsg(string side, float price, float pnlPct) =>
    "EXIT " + side + " @ " + fmtPrice(price) + " PnL " + fmtPrice(pnlPct, 2) + "%"

export logCross(string name, float a, float b) =>
    log.info("{0} cross a={1} b={2}", name, a, b)

slowLen = input.int(26, "Slow", minval=1)
sigLen = input.int(9, "Signal", minval=1)

plotshape(bull, title="Bull", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.bottom, color=#34d399, size=size.tiny)

name: Bollinger Bands
description: Bollinger Bands + %B and bandwidth (overlay).
content:
//@version=6
// @description Bollinger Bands with %B / bandwidth sub-views via plots
indicator("Bollinger Bands", shorttitle="BB", overlay=true)

len = input.int(20, "Length", minval=1)
mult = input.float(2.0, "StdDev", minval=0.1, step=0.1)
src = input.source(close, "Source")

basis = ta.sma(src, len)
dev = mult * ta.stdev(src, len)
upper = basis + dev
lower = basis - dev
pctB = (src - lower) / (upper - lower)
bw = (upper - lower) / basis

plot(basis, "Basis", color=#6366f1)
p1 = plot(upper, "Upper", color=#22d3ee)
p2 = plot(lower, "Lower", color=#22d3ee)
fill(p1, p2, color=color.new(#6366f1, 90), title="Band")
// %B available as hidden series for data window
plot(pctB, "%B", display=display.data_window)
plot(bw, "Bandwidth", display=display.data_window)

name: VWAP Bands
description: Session VWAP ± standard-deviation bands.
content:
//@version=6
// @description Session VWAP with σ bands
indicator("VWAP Bands", shorttitle="VWAP", overlay=true)

src = input.source(hlc3, "Source")
showBands = input.bool(true, "Show bands")
n1 = input.float(1.0, "Band 1 σ", minval=0.1, step=0.1)
n2 = input.float(2.0, "Band 2 σ", minval=0.1, step=0.1)

vw = ta.vwap(src)
// cumulative volume-weighted variance approx via ta.vwap + dev of src
basis = vw
// Use rolling stdev of (src - vwap) as band width proxy
dev = ta.stdev(src - vw, 20)

plot(basis, "VWAP", color=#fbbf24, linewidth=2)
u1 = plot(showBands ? basis + n1 * dev : na, "Upper1", color=#22d3ee)
l1 = plot(showBands ? basis - n1 * dev : na, "Lower1", color=#22d3ee)
u2 = plot(showBands ? basis + n2 * dev : na, "Upper2", color=color.new(#22d3ee, 40))
l2 = plot(showBands ? basis - n2 * dev : na, "Lower2", color=color.new(#22d3ee, 40))
fill(u1, l1, color=color.new(#fbbf24, 92))

name: ATR Volatility
description: ATR + normalized ATR% with dynamic lookback via for-loop.

//@version=6
// @description ATR and ATR% with v6 dynamic for-loop average
indicator("ATR Volatility", shorttitle="ATR", overlay=false)

len = input.int(14, "ATR Length", minval=1)
smooth = input.int(5, "Smooth ATR%", minval=1)

a = ta.atr(len)
atrPct = a / close * 100.0

// v6: dynamic for-loop boundary
float sumPct = 0.0
for i = 0 to smooth - 1
    sumPct += atrPct[i]
avgPct = sumPct / smooth

plot(a, "ATR", color=#6366f1, linewidth=2)
plot(atrPct, "ATR%", color=#22d3ee)
plot(avgPct, "ATR% smooth", color=#fbbf24, style=plot.style_line)

strategy("SMA Crossover", overlay=true, initial_capital=100000,

name: Bollinger Bounce
description: Fade lower band; exit at basis or upper band.
content:
//@version=6
// @description Bollinger mean-reversion bounce
strategy("Bollinger Bounce", overlay=true, initial_capital=100000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=10)

len = input.int(20, "Length")
mult = input.float(2.0, "StdDev", step=0.1)
exitAt = input.string("Basis", "Exit at", options=["Basis", "Upper"])

basis = ta.sma(close, len)
dev = mult * ta.stdev(close, len)
upper = basis + dev
lower = basis - dev

if ta.crossover(close, lower)
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)

float exitLevel = exitAt == "Upper" ? upper : basis
if close > exitLevel and strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.close("Long")

plot(basis, "Basis", color=#6366f1)
plot(upper, "Upper", color=#22d3ee)
plot(lower, "Lower", color=#22d3ee)

name: Supertrend Follow
description: Trend-follow Supertrend flips with ATR factor inputs.
content:
//@version=6
// @description Supertrend trend-following
strategy("Supertrend Follow", overlay=true, initial_capital=100000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=15,
     process_orders_on_close=true)

atrLen = input.int(10, "ATR Length")
factor = input.float(3.0, "Factor", step=0.1)
allowShort = input.bool(false, "Allow short")

[st, dir] = ta.supertrend(factor, atrLen)
// dir < 0 → uptrend in Pine Supertrend convention
bull = dir < 0
bear = dir > 0

if bull and not bull[1]
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
if bear and not bear[1]
    if allowShort
        strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
    else
        strategy.close("Long")

plot(st, "ST", color=bull ? #34d399 : #fb7185, linewidth=2)

name: Donchian Breakout
description: N-bar high breakout entries; exit on channel mid or opposite.
content:
//@version=6
// @description Donchian channel breakout
strategy("Donchian Breakout", overlay=true, initial_capital=100000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=10)

len = input.int(20, "Channel length", minval=2)
exitMid = input.bool(true, "Exit at mid channel")

upper = ta.highest(high, len)
lower = ta.lowest(low, len)
mid = (upper + lower) / 2.0

if ta.crossover(close, upper[1])
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
if exitMid and ta.crossunder(close, mid)
    strategy.close("Long")
if ta.crossunder(close, lower[1])
    strategy.close("Long")

plot(upper, "Upper", color=#22d3ee)
plot(lower, "Lower", color=#22d3ee)
plot(mid, "Mid", color=#94a3b8, style=plot.style_stepline)

name: EMA + ATR Stop
description: EMA trend filter with ATR trailing stop (strategy.exit).
content:
//@version=6
// @description EMA trend + ATR trailing stop
strategy("EMA + ATR Stop", overlay=true, initial_capital=100000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=10)

emaLen = input.int(50, "EMA", minval=1)
atrLen = input.int(14, "ATR", minval=1)
atrMult = input.float(2.5, "ATR mult", step=0.1)

e = ta.ema(close, emaLen)
a = ta.atr(atrLen)

if close > e and ta.crossover(close, e)
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("XL", from_entry="Long", trail_offset=a * atrMult / syminfo.mintick, trail_points=a * atrMult / syminfo.mintick)

plot(e, "EMA", color=#6366f1)

name: Stochastic Cross
description: Stochastic %K/%D cross in oversold/overbought zones.
content:
//@version=6
// @description Stochastic oscillator strategy
strategy("Stochastic Cross", overlay=false, initial_capital=100000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=10)

kLen = input.int(14, "%K Length")
kSmooth = input.int(3, "%K Smooth")
dSmooth = input.int(3, "%D Smooth")
os = input.float(20, "Oversold")
ob = input.float(80, "Overbought")

if ta.crossover(k, d) and k < os

    strategy.close("Long")

hline(os, "OS", color=#34d399)
hline(ob, "OB", color=#fb7185)

name: Session Filtered EMA
description: EMA cross only inside a session window (v6 string session input).
content:
//@version=6
// @description Session-filtered EMA cross
strategy("Session Filtered EMA", overlay=true, initial_capital=100000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=10)

fastLen = input.int(8, "Fast EMA")
slowLen = input.int(21, "Slow EMA")
sess = input.session("0930-1600", "Session")
tz = input.string("America/New_York", "Timezone")

inSess = not na(time(timeframe.period, sess, tz))
fast = ta.ema(close, fastLen)
slow = ta.ema(close, slowLen)

if inSess and ta.crossover(fast, slow)
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
if ta.crossunder(fast, slow) or (not inSess and strategy.position_size > 0)
    strategy.close("Long")

bgcolor(inSess ? color.new(#6366f1, 94) : na)
plot(fast, "Fast", color=#22d3ee)
plot(slow, "Slow", color=#fbbf24)

name: Multi-Signal Enum Engine
description: UDT signal + enum Side + switch routing (showcases newest v6 type system).
content:
//@version=6
// @description Multi-signal engine with enum Side, UDT, and methods
strategy("Multi-Signal Enum Engine", overlay=true, initial_capital=100000,
     default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=10)

enum Side
    flat
    long
    short

type Signal
    Side side
    float strength
    string reason

method isActionable(Signal this) =>
    this.side != Side.flat and this.strength >= 1.0

rsiLen = input.int(14, "RSI Length")
emaLen = input.int(50, "EMA Length")
os = input.float(30, "Oversold")
ob = input.float(70, "Overbought")

r = ta.rsi(close, rsiLen)
e = ta.ema(close, emaLen)

Side trend = close > e ? Side.long : close < e ? Side.short : Side.flat
Side mr = r < os ? Side.long : r > ob ? Side.short : Side.flat

// Combine: require agreement
Side combined = trend == mr and trend != Side.flat ? trend : Side.flat
float strength = combined != Side.flat ? math.abs(r - 50.0) / 10.0 : 0.0
string reason = combined == Side.long ? "trend+OS" : combined == Side.short ? "trend+OB" : "none"

Signal sig = Signal.new(combined, strength, reason)

if sig.isActionable()
    switch sig.side
        Side.long =>
            strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
        Side.short =>
            strategy.close("Long")
        =>
            true

if barstate.islastconfirmedhistory
    log.info("signal side={0} strength={1} reason={2}", str.tostring(sig.side), sig.strength, sig.reason)

plot(e, "EMA", color=#6366f1)
plotshape(sig.side == Side.long and sig.isActionable(), "L", shape.triangleup, location.belowbar, #34d399, size=size.tiny)
